scripts.install:all: bun install --cwd frontend && bun install --cwd backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "bun run --cwd backend dev" "bun run --cwd frontend dev"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd backend build && bun run --cwd frontend build
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "bun run --cwd backend start" "bun run --cwd frontend start"
